site_brief.title: Super for creators and coaches turning conversations into content and operations

summary: A cinematic, conversion-focused niche landing page showing how creators and coaches can use Super’s personal AI agents to turn calls, DMs, and workshops into repeatable content and operational workflows. The page ties current market evidence — especially the rise of computer-use agents like Gemini 3.5 Flash — to creator pain points, and positions Super as the sharper alternative for repeated computer-use workflows through its reusable computer-use cache.
